verdict.rationale: Rippling's docs state that approved hours from Time & Attendance flow instantly into Payroll, that timesheets can be reviewed inside each pay run, and that overtime policies are applied automatically by location before issues reach payroll. All of this is vendor marketing; overtime reaching the pay run is implied by the T&A-to-payroll flow rather than stated outright. missing for 10: explicit documentation that calculated overtime pay lines land in the pay run, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have hourly time entries and overtime flow directly into the payroll run

citations.quote: Approved hours from T&A flow instantly to Payroll—no more manual data entry or syncing issues. You can even review timesheets right inside each pay run.

Rippling automatically applies the correct labor policies—from overtime to breaks—based on location, and flags potential risks based on each employee's work location so managers can act before issues reach payroll.
Sync hours, time off, deductions, and more with payroll from a single global system.
